### Faith and Sanctification
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/faith-and-sanctification
Passage: Acts 26:18
Points:
- Faith not only justifies believers before God but is also essential for their inward sanctification.
- Scripture describes sanctification both as a definitive status in Christ and as an ongoing pursuit of holiness.
- Obeying God in difficult circumstances requires steadfast trust in His character and future reward.
- Believers must continually nourish their faith on Scripture to embrace the cost of discipleship.

### Quiet Walk - September 16
Author: Walk Thru the Bible
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/quiet-walk/quiet-walk-sept-16-11554191.html
Passage: Acts 26:20
Points:
- Biblical repentance means a complete turnaround in heart, mind, and direction.
- Paul emphasized before Agrippa that true conversion must be demonstrated through corresponding actions.
- Coming to Christ grants the new birth and the divine power necessary to change.
- Believers are challenged to inspect their lives for the ongoing fruit of repentance.

### What Acts 26 Taught Me About Evangelism
Author: Lorraine Potter Zechmann
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/acts-26-evangelism/
Passage: Acts 26:1-23
Points:
- Paul's defense illustrates how sharing one's personal testimony naturally points listeners to Jesus and the resurrection.
- Effective witness requires knowing the audience and communicating truth in terms they can comprehend.
- Approaching unbelievers with humility and thoughtful questions defuses defensiveness during spiritual conversations.
- Recognizing that God holds the power to change hearts frees believers to share the gospel patiently and lovingly.
